<a2ui>
surface("status-list")
title = heading("Project tasks")
hint = body("Pick a status to narrow the list. Showing all 8 items.")
filter = segmented_control([{label: "All", value: "all"}, {label: "Done", value: "done"}, {label: "In progress", value: "in_progress"}, {label: "Blocked", value: "blocked"}], "all", "status_filter")
list = entity_list([
  {name: "Set up CI pipeline", subtitle: "Automated builds run on every push to main.", status: "Done"},
  {name: "Design login screen", subtitle: "Final mockups approved by the product team.", status: "Done"},
  {name: "Write API documentation", subtitle: "Endpoints for users and billing are drafted.", status: "In progress"},
  {name: "Migrate user database", subtitle: "Schema changes are running on the staging server.", status: "In progress"},
  {name: "Implement search", subtitle: "Query indexing is half complete.", status: "In progress"},
  {name: "Integrate payment gateway", subtitle: "Waiting on vendor API credentials.", status: "Blocked"},
  {name: "Security audit", subtitle: "Third-party auditor has not yet been scheduled.", status: "Blocked"},
  {name: "Release notes", subtitle: "Draft completed and reviewed by the team.", status: "Done"}
])
root = columns(2, "2rem", "top", [{blocks: [title, hint, filter]}, {blocks: [list]}])
</a2ui>

The filter control and the list are both on the page, but the catalog has no component that connects a selection to the list contents. Choosing a status in the segmented control therefore won't hide the other rows yet. The list shows all eight items, each with a title, a status and a one-line detail.
